title: Compatibility of Picard restriction with H^1 of units
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z\to X of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], the square formed by the pullback map on isomorphism classes of invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], L \mapsto i^*L [def-pc-module-pullback], and the map H^1(X_{\rm Zar},O_X^*) \to H^1(X_{\rm Zar},i_*O_Z^*) = H^1(Z_{\rm Zar},O_Z^*) induced by O_X^* \to i_*O_Z^* and the closed-immersion cohomology identification [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] commutes with the isomorphisms of [thm-sc-hilbert-90] (equivalently, the class of L maps to the class of i^*L). Here H^1 is the cohomology of abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] on the small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and O_X^* is viewed as the units torsor sheaf [def-sc-gm-torsor]; Picard groups use [def-sc-picard-group].

source.place: Lemma 09NY proof, final sentence, together with Cohomology Lemma 02UV and Lemma 09NU

proof.text: For an invertible module L on X, the first isomorphism of [thm-sc-hilbert-90] sends its isomorphism class to the Zariski O_X^*-torsor Isom(O_X,L). Thus the class represented by L is represented by this torsor in H^1(X, O_X^*).

source.place: Lemma 09NY proof, final sentence, using Cohomology Lemma 09NU

proof.text: Pulling the transition isomorphisms of L back along the closed immersion i identifies the pushout of the O_X^*-torsor Isom(O_X,L) along O_X^* -> i_*O_Z^* with the i_*O_Z^*-torsor i_*Isom(O_Z,i^*L): on an open U of X where L|_U = O_U s, the pullback i^*L [def-pc-module-pullback] is free on i^*s over Z \cap U, and u s \mapsto i^\sharp(u) i^*s matches the actions through O_X^* -> i_*O_Z^*. By clause (1) of [lem-sc-torsor-h1-functoriality] applied to O_X^* -> i_*O_Z^*, the induced map H^1(X,O_X^*) -> H^1(X,i_*O_Z^*) sends the class of Isom(O_X,L) to the class of i_*Isom(O_Z,i^*L).

source.place: Lemma 09NY proof, final sentence, together with Cohomology Lemma 09NU

proof.text: By [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] with p=1 and F=O_Z^*, H^1(X,i_*O_Z^*) = H^1(Z,O_Z^*), and by clause (2) of [lem-sc-torsor-h1-functoriality] this identification carries the class of i_*Isom(O_Z,i^*L) to the class of the O_Z^*-torsor Isom(O_Z,i^*L). Applying the first isomorphism of [thm-sc-hilbert-90] on Z, the composite sends [L] to [i^*L], so the stated square commutes.
